The resulting six ideas were then rank ordered by the agents and consensus was reached. All of the calculations were carried out by agents, and the initial draft of the manuscript was also prepared by agents, within a few hours. The resulting prose was often insufficiently detailed, and key references were often missing. GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 were recruited to check the examples, generate a few further examples and try, unsuccessfully, to find a proof of the conjecture.
